caseNameFull: Dorrance v. Martin, State Tax Commissioner and Camden Safe Deposit & Trust Co. v. Same
attorneys: Mr. Wm. A. Schnader for petitioners in No. 1017. Mr. Merritt Lane for petitioners in Nos. 1018 and 1055. Messrs. George 8. Hobart and Duane E. Minard for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petitions for writs of certiorari to the Court of Errors and Appeals of New Jersey denied.

Mr. Justice Stone took no part in the consideration and decision of these applications.
